BiblicalUsage: Eve is the first woman, named by Adam after the fall because she is the mother of all living. She conceives and bears Cain and says she has gotten a man from the LORD, and her name carries the whole story of life after the fall.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Eve's name is hope spoken in the middle of judgement: mother of all living, named when death had just entered the world. Life goes on because God said it would.
